messages.text: BL-2042 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfix f1b8d5f2b7: the babysitter's seat-stuck clock counted a seat's commit only when its byline was exactly `By <stage>.`, so an annotated byline never reset it and seat-stuck-coder re-fired seven times on a coder that had committed BL-1843 work
